_note: Seeded history for the demo, from before the simulated 90 days. Invented for the demo, not real farm data. 'day' is the UI's day index: 0 = 30 Aug 2026, 89 = 27 Nov 2026; -79 = 12 Jun, -168 = 15 Mar.

episodes.text: Delousing with crowding in Pen 3 dropped oxygen to about 45% saturation at 5–15 m on the downstream side, in weak current.
episodes.outcome: Confirmed. Feeding paused 6 h; oxygen recovered the next day once crowding ended. No mortality spike.

episodes.text: After a storm, the old net in Pen 7 sagged onto the sinker tube; chafe and fraying at 17.5–20 m on the weather side.
episodes.outcome: Confirmed on close inspection. Weights re-set and the area repaired before a twine broke.
